id: title:adamleithp:frame the today panes in a desktop style inset

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the conditional rendering and CSS class application in the Navigation component to support a new layout mode where the sidebar is framed and the top rail is absent, while adding a backdrop and frame elements. This could affect the visual appearance and layout behavior of the Today Rail and Sidebar in the frontend, potentially changing how users interact with the navigation.
review.reason: Adds a new conditional variable and conditional rendering for a framed layout mode, while removing the top border and logo area from the Today Rail, and adding corresponding CSS and JSX for the frame and backdrop. This is a narrow, localized frontend maintenance and behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and user impact are not demonstrated; this is a description of the change, not a measurement of adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
